decision: started the workbench goal on a new branch codex/workbench from the redesign tip
why: keep the redesign branch clean and make the overnight work reviewable on its own

decision: chose a Python pty bridge over node-pty for the terminal
why: node-pty 1.1.0 failed posix_spawnp on this Mac and ships no Linux prebuild, so the Bot Box would need a compiler; python3 pty is in the standard library on both
evidence: /tmp/ptytest node-pty error; /tmp/pybridge PTY OK with resize 40x120

decision: chose streamed HTTP (chunked GET plus POST input) over WebSocket for terminal transport
why: in Mac dev the browser reaches Pi only through the Next API proxy, which forwards HTTP but not upgrades; streaming works through both paths and Tailscale without a new dependency

decision: wrote docs/WORKBENCH.md: tab model, layout, every host route, path confinement, terminal long-poll, browser proxy limits
why: the brief asks for the contract before code so parallel lanes share one shape

decision: built the split pane: + toggle, resizable divider, tabs, launcher, mobile sheet, persisted state, capabilities and suggestions host routes
why: foundation every tool pane plugs into; tools show disabled with the host's reason until built
result: gate: tsc+lint clean, 50 unit, 7/7 browser, build ok, native 19/22 (3 known Mac-only), detector []

decision: fixed a persistence bug where the default state was saved before the stored one was restored
why: the browser check caught the workbench not reopening after reload

decision: made scripts/check-syntax.mjs recurse into host subdirectories
why: the new packages/pi-host/workbench folder would otherwise never be syntax-checked
evidence: scripts/check-syntax.mjs; planted bad file made it exit 1

decision: shortened effort stop labels (Min, Med, XHigh) when a model has more than five levels; full name stays in the hint and title
why: the brief asked to fix Extra high being clipped in the model menu

decision: launched five tool lanes in worktrees: files, changes, pages+side chat, terminal, browser+services+extensions
why: tools are independent and own disjoint files; shared files have one marked slot per lane

decision: merged Files and Changes lanes; wrote scripts/resolve-workbench-slots.py and check-fixture-lane-blocks.py
why: the slot files conflict on neighbouring lines every merge; a script resolves them the same way each time and a second script proves no lane's fixture routes were lost
evidence: commit after de8a3c8; both lane blocks identical
result: gate: 63 unit, 9/9 browser, native 21/24 (3 known Mac-only)

decision: fixed a dropped closing brace in the files fixture block after the first union merge
why: git put the block's last line in the shared suffix; node --check caught it

decision: kept the Changes lane's extra hardening: repo-configured clean/smudge/process filters are switched off
why: the lane proved plain git status executed a filter command planted in a repo's config
evidence: packages/pi-host/check-workbench-changes.mjs filter test; failed when hardening removed
